chunks: Al-Kafi: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, from Wuhayb ibn Hafs, from Abi Basir who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed, the Qur’an is a Chaser and a Caller. It calls to the Garden and chases away from the Fire.

key_terms.آمِرٌ: A caller or exhorter that invites to something
key_terms.زَاجِرٌ: A deterrent or chaser that drives away from something

ai.seo_question: What are the two main functions of the Qur'an according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the Qur’an’s dual pedagogical function as both an exhorter (amir) inviting believers to Paradise and a deterrent (zajir) warning them from Hellfire. This narration underscores the practical utility of the Qur’an in shaping moral conduct through the balanced mechanisms of hope and fear, a concept central to Shia exegetical tradition regarding the text's transformative power.
